summary: Zones the vehicle may serve tasks in.
range: Array of integer zone IDs. Empty array = only zone-less tasks. Omitted = all zones.
businessRules: Empty allowed_zones restricts the vehicle to tasks with no zone.
A task in a non-allowed zone cannot be served by this vehicle.

allowed_zones defines: Specifies the zones where the vehicle is allowed to fulfil any tasks. Please note the following: * If this parameter is provided, then the vehicle can fulfil tasks only in the given zones but, it i…
Each element in allowed_zones must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: jobs.zones, vehicles.restricted_zones. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Vehicle's allowed_zones must include the job/shipment's zones.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
Vehicle and job zones must intersect. Vehicle without zone restrictions can serve any zone.
testingGuidance: Infeasible: a job in zone 2 with no vehicle allowed there -> unassigned.
Boundary: empty allowed_zones + a zoned job -> unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: job in zone 2 with every vehicle restricting or not allowing zone 2 -> unassigned.
Interaction: Positive: job zones [1], vehicle allowed_zones [1] -> served.
